ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)

host_pcb_constraints_summary: PCD antenna design: planar coil tuned to 13.56 MHz, Q ≈ 30..40, area ≈ 70 mm × 50 mm (Class 1 antenna geometry).
PCD matching network: LCL or T-network with adjustable capacitors for VSWR ≤ 1.5:1 at 13.56 MHz; tolerate ± 10% antenna L variation.
PCD EMC filter: low-pass at ~ 25 MHz to suppress harmonic emissions; FCC Part 15 / ETSI EN 300 330 compliance.
PCD power supply: separate AVDD / DVDD / PVDD rails with bulk decoupling (≥ 10 µF tantalum + 100 nF ceramic) and antenna driver supply held within spec under modulation transient (≤ 100 mV droop).
PCD ESD protection: TVS diodes on antenna terminals (Class 3B per IEC 61000-4-2).
PCD crystal: 27.12 MHz (2× carrier) ± 30 ppm for low-jitter carrier synthesis (chip-vendor-specific).
PCD layout: keep TX1/TX2 / RX traces matched-length, short, and shielded from digital noise.
fields.picc_internal_constraints: PICC-internal silicon constraints (antenna tuning capacitor C_tune, rectifier diode V_drop, shunt-regulator clamp voltage, modulation FET RDS_on) are vendor-specific and intentionally out of scope of AN10833. PICC analog-pad signoff is at the LA / LB terminals only; antenna geometry (typical 5..7 turns at 50 × 80 mm for Class 1) is laminated into the card body and trim-capped to centre the resonance at 13.56 MHz under typical environmental conditions.
fields.notes: ISO/IEC 14443-2 defines the air-interface electrical envelope (carrier frequency, modulation indices, rise/fall times, field strengths) but does not specify host PCB layout or PDK timing constraints. PCD reader chip vendors (NXP, ST, TI) publish reference designs with antenna footprint + matching network + EMC + ESD recommendations. The PICC silicon side ships with vendor-specific design rules for the antenna-PICC interface — not standardised across vendors.
